RECOMMENDATION: IT DEPENDS
LIKELIHOOD: 35

An all-male panel is not evidence of discrimination by itself — it's common in senior media and often reflects who holds those posts. But it is legitimate context: it weakens any claim the process was robust, and panel composition is something many public broadcasters have formal policies on.

Don't lead with it. Lead with the concrete points: your unanswered request for written reasons (two weeks is unreasonable, and in many jurisdictions you're entitled to them), and the gap between fifteen years' experience including five as deputy versus eight. "Strong digital experience" may be genuine — digital capability is a real priority — or a post-hoc justification. The reasons you're owed will tell you which. Mention the panel as one factor, not your case.
